--- Page 1 ---
Section 1: General Safety Information.
Always wear ANSI-approved eye protection and thermal gloves when operating heating chamber H-500.

--- Page 2 ---
   
   

--- Page 3 ---
Section 2: Emergency Shutdown Sequence.
1. Depress main emergency stop switch S1.
2. Cut fuel supply via valve FV-01.
3. Evacuate chamber enclosure immediately.
